slice.rule: the whole entry, byte for byte as files.rcsb.org answered it — one 169 KB file is not a slice of anything
slice.loses: nothing of this entry. What the DESK reads is narrower than the file: the ETL keeps the backbone N, CA and C atoms the dihedrals need and treats no water as protein. It COUNTS every record it skipped and why (src/prot/etl.ts · skippedOf), so the cut is reported in numbers the parse produced rather than in numbers somebody typed here.

note: Regenerating re-downloads the entry. The archive revises entries (this one last in 1999), so a re-run that changes the bytes changes the sha256 above — which is the point of recording it.
